comparison_to_post_q6_direct_profile.interpretation: The pair producer saves more time than the net kernel-sum reduction because unrelated one-shot profiler families drift upward. The binding wall-clock evidence remains the already-published counterbalanced full-engine A/B, not either profiler wall.

next_lane.reason: The remaining Q5 producer is the only source-F16 format transform that still assigns one workgroup to each scalar output column even though the sole-resident T16 payload shares every low-nibble byte across an adjacent column pair and every high-bit byte across an eight-column group. A pair- or octet-owned producer can traverse each packed byte once, preserve each column's d/dmin/scale/min expression and exact F16 publication, and feed the already-qualified unchanged rocBLAS consumer without a sidecar, new workspace, or arithmetic-policy change.
next_lane.first_gate: Add separate exact Q5 pair- and/or octet-owned F16 producer leaves, freeze source-F16 bytes at nonzero tile offsets, and compare producer-inclusive dequantize + production rocBLAS + BF16 output on the actual K6144/N5120 recurrent-output weight at production M512/1024/4096 on both gfx1100 boards. Stop at the leaf unless every required cell wins; only then select the producer inside the existing model-scoped Q5 composite and repeat changed-arithmetic/full-engine safeguards.
next_lane.ceiling_note: The immediate isolated producer ceiling is 8.268 ms / 1.58% of M512 kernel sum; no claim assumes all of it is removable.
excluded_by_fresh_profile: Do not reopen Q5 integer MMQ, row reuse, or a resident representation change. Those mechanisms are already rejected or superseded; this target changes only packed-byte ownership inside the qualified source-F16 producer.
Do not reopen dual-Q4 FFN geometry or whole-matrix accumulator serialization without a mechanism that avoids the measured second activation traversal and crosses a concrete occupancy boundary.

Do not reopen remaining exact-Q4 singleton source-F16, GDN, attention, cast-only, fill/copy, or launch-count-only work; their current ceilings and prior boundary evidence remain non-binding for the prefill gate.

decision: Retain the qualified selective Q4 pair producer unchanged, publish its reconciled 5.224-ms producer saving, and screen exact packed-column ownership in the remaining Q5 source-F16 producer next. This profiler artifact changes no production path and makes no new throughput claim.
